hooks.text: 驾驶载具拆除旧世界废墟并就地建造聚落
hooks.excerpt: Part city builder, part retro vehicle shooter. Tear down the ruins of the old world and use what you find to build a settlement.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 营救荒原幸存者并以建筑摆位抵挡失控AI敌潮
hooks.excerpt: Rescue survivors from the wastes. Defend your people against waves of attacks from the rogue AI that ruined the old world. Procedural levels and random build order make every run unique. Carve your way through the post-post-apocalyptic sprawl to find valuable resources and rescue settlers. Every building you construct and how you position it affects your settlement's chance of survival.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 程序化关卡与随机建造顺序重排每次重建路线
hooks.excerpt: Procedural levels and random build order make every run unique.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏内容过短，重开价值低。

excerpts.excerpt: 几个多小时就通关了，内容量不大，通关后重开的价值不高。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 胜负过度受随机种子影响。

excerpts.excerpt: 运气对胜负的影响太大了。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 开车拆家与塔防结合巧妙。

excerpts.excerpt: 把“开车拆家”和“塔防”结合得挺巧妙。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
